description: A front-facing figure holds a tall upright spear at the left and a round shield at the right. The shield has a central circular boss, and a horizontal belt crosses the figure’s torso.
Two overlapping triangles point in opposite directions to form a six-pointed star. Their intersecting sides enclose a central hexagon, with a small notch visible at the uppermost and lowermost tips.

Three long fortune sticks rise at different angles from an open cylindrical holder. The outer sticks lean outward around a shorter central stick, and an elliptical rim crosses behind and in front of their bases.
A round coin has a broad circular rim surrounding a smaller concentric ring. A square opening sits at its center, with straight edges contrasting against the circular outline.
A long-haired figure in a draped garment holds an upright branching stalk in the extended right arm. A swept fringe crosses the face, while curved folds run diagonally across the torso.

A front-facing devil has a broad forehead tapering to a pointed chin, with two upward-curving horns and pointed ears. Slanted eyes and a downturned mouth give the otherwise symmetrical face a stern expression.
A small upright figure has a round head with two short horns, rounded shoulders, and a narrow lower body. A curved tail grows from its right side and ends in an upward-right arrowhead.
A long-snouted animal head faces right above a straight neck and small shoulder line. A tall pointed ear rises at the back, and a hanging headdress descends behind the neck with vertical folds.
A right-facing animal-headed bust has a projecting beak-like muzzle and a curved neck beneath a large circular sun disk. A short serpentine line extends from the disk toward the upper right.

An almond-shaped eye sits beneath a long arched eyebrow, with both outlines extending horizontally to the left. A dark pupil sits inside the iris, and a vertical stroke and sweeping curved line descend below the eye.
A front-facing woman has long wavy hair framing a blank rounded face. A wide elliptical halo sits above her head, and a diagonal garment fold crosses the curved shoulders below.
A broad rounded cup has a flat upper rim and a narrow band below it. Its bowl narrows into a short ornamental stem, which flares outward into a low flat foot.
A long-haired figure in a draped garment extends one arm to hold a tall scepter with a round finial. A swept fringe crosses the face, and curved garment folds sweep diagonally across the body.
A boot points down-left with a rounded toe and a slanting open shaft. A large wing attaches at the heel and rises toward the upper right, with three curved feather divisions along its trailing edge.
A front-facing head wears a domed helmet with a curved band across the forehead. Small feathered wings project symmetrically from its sides, above a blank face, short neck, and rounded shoulders.
A long-haired figure in a draped tunic extends one arm toward a flame hovering directly above the hand. The flame has a curved pointed tip and a smaller inward notch on its right side.
Two complete overlapping triangles point upward and downward to form a symmetrical six-pointed star. Their crossing sides create a central hexagon surrounded by six small triangular openings.
A person faces left while kneeling on folded legs, with a round head above a slightly forward-leaning torso. Both forearms angle upward in front of the chest toward the raised hands.
A tall crescent opens to the right, with its two pointed tips framing an outlined five-pointed star. The star sits centrally in the crescent’s open side without touching it.
A left-facing person sits back on folded lower legs beneath an upright torso and round head. One long arm slopes down toward the knees, with the forearm meeting the lap.

A tall cuboid building is viewed toward a front corner, exposing two side walls and a peaked upper outline. A continuous horizontal band wraps around the upper walls, bending at the central vertical corner.
A front-facing person kneels on a broad mat whose sides spread toward the viewer. A headscarf frames the circular face and wraps around the shoulders, with short arms beside the rounded lower body.
A stick-like figure stands with spread legs and raised bent arms. A round head sits between two wide branching antlers, whose outer tips and shorter inner tines turn upward.
Two slightly splayed posts support a broad upper beam with upward-curving ends. A straight lower crossbar passes across both posts beneath the top beam, leaving an open gateway below.
A symmetrical emblem has a tall central double-edged blade passing through a circular ring. Two broad curved swords flank the ring, sweep inward, and cross at the bottom.
Two mirrored hands curve upward around the lower sides of a large circular sphere. Their outer fingers point vertically, while the thumbs and palms angle inward beneath the sphere’s lower edge.
Three curved arms meet at a central junction and spiral outward in a threefold arrangement. One curl rises above the center, while the other two spread toward the lower left and lower right.
A circle is divided into two interlocking rounded halves by a flowing S-shaped boundary. Each half contains a small circular mark, placed on opposite sides of the central curve.

A front-facing crowned figure has long wavy hair, a broad beard, and curved shoulders. The crown has three raised points above a straight band, and one small eye mark appears on the otherwise sparse face.
A long-haired figure in a draped garment extends one arm beneath a large lightning bolt at the right. The bolt’s pointed zigzag silhouette rises above the hand beside the figure’s head.
